en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Educational aim is to prepare the student in order to be able to evaluate the qualities, contamination and ecotoxicity of water ecosystems. To understand actual problems of water environment pollution and to be able to carry out and evaluate the acute toxicity tests with organisms in water environment.
